foundation:photon-mass.title: Light, energy and invariant mass
foundation:photon-mass.limitation: Single fixed-energy dispersion control. Does not derive the gap, its origin or an astronomical drag law.

foundation:constant-time.title: One progression, different clock readings
foundation:constant-time.limitation: Constant stipulated rates; the SR comparator is an inertial control, not a derivation of preferred time.

foundation:light-slowing.title: Distinguishing energy loss from slowing

foundation:light-slowing.limitation: Normalized fixed C, initial E=1, drag imposed rather than derived. No microscopic bath or universal cosmology.

foundation:when.title: Time as event ordering
foundation:when.limitation: Stationary endpoints, constant transit delay, identical clock units; not a synchronization theory or a full redshift model.

foundation:where.title: Space as measurable relations

foundation:where.limitation: Flat two-dimensional geometry; not a model of curved geometry, cosmological distance or absolute coordinates.

foundation:physical-existence.title: Physical attributes and system mass
foundation:physical-existence.limitation: Two massless packets of equal energy; no localization measurement or proof that every entity has a sharp size.

foundation:spacetime.title: Geometry versus a literal fabric
foundation:spacetime.limitation: Inertial special-relativity reference only. No gravitational metric calculation or replacement theory is supplied.

foundation:fastest-signal.title: Group speed and causal speed
foundation:fastest-signal.limitation: Normalized stationary paths; the front is a specified reference, not an experimentally detected new faster field.

foundation:separation.title: Closing and separation rates versus causality
foundation:separation.limitation: Equal opposite inertial velocities, not a cosmological metric or a superluminal communication mechanism.

foundation:cosmic-size.title: Observable reach and total cosmic extent

source.title: ArcSecs Scientific Review 6.0
source.section: §2, printed pp. 6–7; Review 6.0 §2; book Chapter 26 and Chapters 30–32

foundation:cosmic-size.limitation: Stationary Euclidean centered sphere with prescribed reach; not a calculation of the actual observable universe or its size.

foundation:cosmic-age.title: Modeled cosmic age and total history
foundation:cosmic-age.limitation: Flat matter–Λ reference, radiation omitted for this analytic lesson; no data fit or inference about all reality.

foundation:distance-inference.title: When astronomical distances and sizes can change

foundation:distance-inference.limitation: Signed magnitude offset is a sensitivity control; negative values model calibration/brightening bias, not physical negative dust extinction. No universal correction or astronomical fit.

light.title: Energy loss and group speed
light.description: Compare positive-gap drag with the zero-gap control at each identical drag rate.

clocks.title: Physical clock prediction versus SR
clocks.description: Compare a stipulated candidate clock rate with the SR count at the same reference rate, speed and duration. The two predictions are distinct outputs of one solver.

escape.title: Escape versus reversible conversion
escape.description: Sweep escape strength, keeping the zero-escape comparator fixed at the same duration. Compare terminal total conversion, not individual photon slowing.

wall.title: Competing drag bounds
wall.description: Compare the entry-monotonicity lower bound with the strict crossing upper bound for the same wall assumptions. Positive difference is a conflict, not a feasible interval.

distance.title: Signed astronomical inference bias
distance.description: Compare inferred distance with the calibrated geometric input under the same extinction offset. This does not establish a universal correction.

age.title: Conventional expansion-age sensitivity
age.description: Compare two flat matter–Λ reference histories with differing matter fractions. This is not a comparison of a parent cosmos with observed cosmology.

anchors.title: Geometric anchor sensitivity
anchors.description: Compare proposed downward distance shifts with unchanged LMC calibration. Quoted combined uncertainty is not a new likelihood or a detection.
